verdict.rationale: Fly.io runs arbitrary Docker images as fast-booting VMs close to users over a global Anycast network, so code in non-JavaScript languages can run at the edge. Elixir is explicitly supported, and the docs point to tech-specific guides. However, this is a container/VM model rather than an edge-functions runtime. Missing for 10: explicit documentation of Python, Go, or Rust support; a function-style (per-request, serverless) edge programming model; hands-on corroboration of multi-language edge deployments.
